notablePrerequisites:
Priest of Titania and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's second ability by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Priest of Titania.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Priest of Titania.
Repeat.
